trial_title: SYN CARDIO 001 Acute Myocardial Infarction Clinical Trial Protocol

inclusion_criteria.text: Age 18 years or older at time of signing informed consent.
inclusion_criteria.source_excerpt: Age 18 years or older at time of signing informed consent.

inclusion_criteria.text: Confirmed acute myocardial infarction STEMI or NSTEMI with elevated troponin.
inclusion_criteria.source_excerpt: Confirmed acute myocardial infarction STEMI or NSTEMI with elevated troponin.

inclusion_criteria.text: Index AMI occurred within 7 days prior to study randomization.
inclusion_criteria.source_excerpt: Index AMI occurred within 7 days prior to study randomization.

inclusion_criteria.text: Hemodynamically stable: systolic BP >= 90 mmHg without vasopressor support.
inclusion_criteria.source_excerpt: Hemodynamically stable: systolic BP >= 90 mmHg without vasopressor support.

exclusion_criteria.text: Active major bleeding or clinically significant bleeding diathesis.
exclusion_criteria.source_excerpt: Active major bleeding or clinically significant bleeding diathesis.

exclusion_criteria.text: Severe hepatic impairment or clinically active liver disease.
exclusion_criteria.source_excerpt: Severe hepatic impairment or clinically active liver disease.

exclusion_criteria.text: Cardiogenic shock requiring mechanical circulatory support.
exclusion_criteria.source_excerpt: Cardiogenic shock requiring mechanical circulatory support.

other_requirements: Written informed consent obtained prior to trial enrollment.
